newsitem.title: USA: Guyana president Jagan remains seriously ill.
newsitem.headline: Guyana president Jagan remains seriously ill.

text.p: Guyana's President Cheddi Jagan remained in very serious condition on Wednesday after heart surgery two weeks ago, a spokesman for the Walter Reed Army Medical Centre said.
"He is listed as very seriously ill," the spokesman said.
Jagan, 78, took a turn for the worse on Monday with his blood pressure fluctuating dangerously and water gathering in his lungs.
Doctors at the centre performed a procedure called an angioplasty to clear blocked arteries after Jagan was flown from Georgetown on Feb. 15 suffering from heart pains.
